81348.subject: Weekly Recap: Freezes Lag as Initia Halts Its Chain
81348.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

**Security** set the week. On Tuesday, Blockaid counted 60 exploits this year in which stablecoin blacklists returned nothing to victims. Then a Railway breach exposed developers' keys, PHP flaws sent governments to warn website operators, and on Friday **Initia** halted its chain after a bridge drain while Agora's freeze came after the money had moved.

Onchain, **Morpho** and Pendle opened lending and leverage on tokenized stocks, and Kraken passed 1,000 xStocks. **Aero** merged Aerodrome and Velodrome, Starknet's poll closed at 93.52% for Layer 1 research, and Ethereum developers cancelled Glamsterdam on Hoodi. The most-read story of the week was **Anthropic's** report that Claude traced how five NIST curves got their seeds.

Enjoy!

**Camila Russo** asks Backpack founder **Armani Ferrante** what a buyer owns in each tokenized-stock model, from transfer agents to SPV debt securities. He explains Backpack's 1:1 redeemable shares, which move between a brokerage and DeFi, and how 24/7 trading and in-kind dividends work. **[Watch the full conversation.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d0BnnXBgY3I)**

# Top Stories This Week

## Freezes Caught Little as Initia Halted Its Chain

On Tuesday, Blockaid found that stablecoin issuer blacklists [recovered nothing in 60 exploits](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/issuer-blacklists-recovered-nothing-in-60-crypto-exploits-blockaid-finds) from January to August, while chain and protocol controls held 99% of the $91.2 million frozen or recovered. The same day, a Drift-linked wallet [sent 23,000 ETH into Tornado Cash](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/drift-linked-wallet-sends-54-8-million-in-eth-to-tornado-cash). CoinDCX [first denied a new breach](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/coindcx-co-founder-denies-new-hack-after-16-million-wallet-alert), then [acknowledged losses from a failed deposit-collection process](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/coindcx-acknowledges-wallet-sweeping-losses-after-denying-new-breach), and Tether [froze about $2.2 million](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/tether-blacklists-usdt-wallets-linked-to-coindcx-outflows) of the roughly $16 million outflow. On Friday, Initia [halted its Layer 1 and rollups](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/initia-halts-l1-and-rollups-after-reported-mint-exploit) after a reported mint exploit. Agora [froze the attacker's AUSD account](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/agora-freezes-ausd-account-linked-to-initia-exploit) 89 minutes after the AUSD was swapped away, by our arithmetic.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk-off Saturday: Bitcoin lost its 50-day average as ETF outflows and a tech sell-off weighed, while an Initia exploit, tokenization pushback and Netanyahu's sanctions-dodging blockchain talk kept security and policy in focus. 📉 Bitcoin Slips Below Its 50-Day Average as ETF Outflows Pile Up Bitcoin closed Friday below its 50-day moving average for the first time since mid-August, ending a 66-day streak, and drifted toward $80,500 on Saturday. US spot BTC ETFs shed about $636 million on Thursday and another $138 million on Friday, as an AI-driven tech sell-off kept risk appetite weak ahead of the Fed's October 28 decision. Read full story 🚨 Initia Halts Its Blockchain After $2.7M Infinite-Mint Exploit Initia froze its Layer 1 and connected rollups at 15:41 UTC on Friday after an attacker abused a flaw in a Move minting function to create unbacked AUSD tokens. More details 🏛️ SEC Puts "Super Intelligence" and Tokenization on Its 2027 Exam Radar The SEC's Division of Examinations published its fiscal 2027 priorities, replacing "artificial intelligence" with "super intelligence and other advanced technologies" and naming tokenization as a key risk area. Crypto oversight now sits almost entirely under the tokenization heading, signalling where examiners will focus as on-chain stock trading expands. Read more 🏦 Wells Fargo, Arm and Intuit Block Tokenization of Their Shares Six more companies, including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit, have refused to let OKXICE, the OKX and Intercontinental Exchange joint venture, offer tokenized versions of their stock, Reuters reported citing a regulatory document. That brings objecting issuers to 22, against the 63 stocks the venue had planned to tokenize. ## Claude now works even when you're not using it

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/79ab6baa-eb02-42e2-8e53-8f68f568df3a/72ba3c39-79c6-482f-b365-56c0284e5072.jpg?t=1792657790)
Caption: 

Anthropic launched [Claude Duet](https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-duet), an assistant that works in the background and keeps you updated without waiting for you to start a chat.

It runs on its own cloud computer and asks before doing anything sensitive. For now, it's a waitlist research preview for Pro and Max subscribers in the US.

Then Anthropic said [sessions in Claude's apps](https://x.com/claudeai/status/2113360845409583307) will run in auto mode by default starting next week, so Claude stops asking you to approve every step.

Claude is getting comfortable working without you.


----------







----------
## AI found decade-old holes in the code behind most websites

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/778c44dd-6634-4f03-acb5-507e4041f55a/b20c7654-9b8a-426f-89c8-0418a3adc82f.jpg?t=1792657786)
Caption: 

Two critical flaws had been hiding for more than a decade in PHP, the code behind about 70% of websites. [Wiz found them](https://www.wiz.io/blog/php2shell-php-rce) with help from AI models made by OpenAI and Google.

Cloudflare saw thousands of attack attempts before the bugs were even announced, then millions after. The NSA told companies to patch or go offline.

By the end of the week, people online were calling it [Black October](https://tech.yahoo.com/cybersecurity/articles/black-october-disclosure-wave-label-023233848.html) as one hack
